name: Sorshen's Devotion
text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You or an ally within 60 feet uses Rewrite Fate to reroll a saving throw

---
Effect Spend 1 Mythic Point. The triggering creature regains 7d10+28 healing Hit Points. The amount of healing increases to 10d10+40 healing Hit Points if Xanderghul, the Runelord of Pride, was the source of the triggering effect.
